National Laboratory of the Rockies | 36 Tracking in-use and emerging large load tariffs • Potential exists for collaboration based upon existing datasets (EPRI, SEPA DELTa)1,2 to produce an NLR-vetted, public database of emerging large load tariffs. • Database could include elements such as rates, demand flexibility, interruptible vs. firm service requirements, and cost allocation. • Large load tariffs could comprise another layer of NLR’s rates database (USURDB)3 and be combined with geospatial data on data center locations. • Next steps would likely entail discussing with Source: SEPA DELTa. potential collaborators, understanding web- scraping tools to scrape ongoing regulatory proceedings and approved tariff filings. 1 Retail Flexible Load Tariff Sample Dataset.
